sides.name: Kingdom of France (d'Albret, Boucicaut)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. 14,000-15,000 combatants, up to 25,000 counting armed servants (Rogers): ~10,000 men-at-arms (most dismounted = infantry_line, 800-2,400 mounted on the wings = cavalry_heavy), 4,000-5,000 archers and crossbowmen (barely used). Up to 10,000 gros valets present but not engaged: mid 0. Curry's lower figure (~12,000) inside the low end. Armor 4.6: full plate. Command 0.3: divided command, crowded front between woods.

sides.name: Kingdom of England (Henry V)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. 6,000-8,100 (modern estimates): about 5/6 longbowmen, 1/6 dismounted men-at-arms. Weapons 4.5: massed longbow. Archers fought behind sharpened stakes (field fortification; not a fortified city). Morale 0.7: sick and hungry but desperate. Training 0.75: indentured professionals.

outcome.note: English victory. French ~6,000 killed (mostly nobility) and 700-2,200 captured. English up to 600 killed, 112 identified (Curry); wounded unrecorded, added by educated guess. Fighting lasted about three hours after a three-hour standoff; heavy rain overnight made the ploughed field mud.
